name: dsh-behavior-guard
description: DSH behavior governance suite: L0-L3 premature-finish guard (verified-finish L1 file claims), D1/D2/D3 deterministic signals (repeat probing / same-args double fail / redundant todo), adaptive-window live audit, corrector with read-only executor, and verify_agent proxy acceptance. Built and battle-tested on a local Qwen3.6-35B agent (2026-11).

dsh.description: 早收尾拦截（L0-L3）+ 确定性信号（重复探测/同参失败/冗余 todo）+ 自适应窗口实时审计 + 纠正器 + 只读代执行 + 代验收。
